standard-dialogue-after-plague-city.npc: Ah hello. Thank you again for rescuing my daughter.

standard-dialogue-after-the-song-of-the-.npc: Hello there friend. I hope you're looking after Elena out there.

standard-dialogue-after-the-song-of-the-.player: I think she might be the one looking after me.

treasure-trails-medium.player: Possibly, do you have a challenge for me?

treasure-trails-medium.npc: Yes, I do as a matter of fact.

treasure-trails-medium.text: Edmond has given you a challenge scroll!

treasure-trails-medium-when-holding-the-.npc: Please enter the answer to the question.

steps.npc: Is that your final answer? Because it sounds unlikely to me.

steps.text: Edmond has given you another clue scroll!
